coding.observation: generations.observe(message) before business branches; tracing enables includePartialMessages
coding.identity: message ID deduplication; parent_tool_use_id separates active streams
coding.finish: message_stop or terminal complete assistant fallback
coding.abort: explicit aborted assistant error; unconfirmed output usage unknown
coding.exception: active generations fail on SDK iterator exception
coding.emission: one daemon.ai.generation span and corresponding AI event share trace/span identity; metadata-only
coding.terminalResult: aggregate data-usage, not another generation; no modelUsage/num_turns or independent per-message ledger exported
coding.aggregateUsageBoundary: terminal and per-generation cache semantics differ; do not assert naive sums or distribute terminal cost across generations

independentExistingMetadata: model_call_timing keyed by workflowRunId/stepId/attempt and outcome
turn_timing.modelCalls equals result.steps.length for successful turns
coordinator.limits: resolution/auth failures need not be provider generations; successful turn count is not coding subprocess count or all failed attempts

evidence.forbiddenClaim: AI/APM equality, CLI exit or local queue flush proves every hidden upstream CLI call/retry was captured

conditionalUnobservedBoundary.condition: SDK returns normal EOF while collector still holds started generation without terminal frame
conditionalUnobservedBoundary.behavior: adapter normal EOF goes through diedEarly; generations.fail is in exception catch
